what: Claude Code v2.1.114 binary contains undocumented `asyncRewake`, `rewakeMessage`, and `rewakeSummary` fields in BashCommandHookSchema (settings.json hook config). `asyncRewake: true` "runs the hook in background and wakes the model on exit code 2". `rewakeSummary` (@internal) is the user-visible terminal label, defaulting to "Stop hook feedback" (NOT "blocking error"). `rewakeMessage` (@internal) is the prefix for the system-reminder sent to the model. Verified by extracting strings from /Users/meky/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.114 — schema fields at offsets 158508–158511, 158532–158534; user-facing label "Stop hook feedback" at offsets 203427/203632. Possibly only wired for Teammate/Task hooks, not yet confirmed empirically for Stop. If it works for Stop, it's the cleanest fix for the "Stop hook returned blocking error" first-impression issue.
why: Explored as part of BLOCK_ERRORS_UX_EXPLORATION.md. This is non-obvious (only found via binary string extraction), directly actionable for the primary hook UX problem, and could change across minor versions since @internal — so future sessions should re-verify before shipping.
